references.text: Noah was 500 years old when he had his sons, which provides the background for the timeline leading up to the flood when he was 600.
God's announcement that He would send a worldwide flood, fulfilled in Genesis 7:6.
Detailed description of the start of the flood in Noah's 600th year, expanding and clarifying Genesis 7:6.
Noah's total lifespan of 950 years, including 350 years after the flood—confirming his age at the start of the flood.
Jesus compares His return to the days of Noah, referring directly to the flood that came upon the earth.
By faith Noah built an ark to save his household, having been warned about what was not yet seen.
Refers to Noah's ark and the eight who were saved through water as a symbol of baptism and salvation.
God did not spare the ancient world but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, when He brought the flood.
The world at that time was flooded by water and perished—a direct reference to the flood in Noah's time.
Creates a narrative framework showing the duration of the flood and God's control over time.
Completes the timeline by combining the starting point with the duration of the waters' strength.
Explains why Noah was in the ark when the flood came: his righteousness and walking with God.
Explains the theological reason for survival: God's grace before the flood.
